title: Greek Lentil Stuffed Dolmades Keto
description: A keto twist on traditional dolmades, these stuffed grape leaves are packed with flavorful lentils and innovative spices.
instructions: Prepare the grape leaves by blanching them in boiling water for 30 seconds to remove bitterness.
In a mixing bowl, combine cooked lentils, chopped spring onions, Greek yogurt, innovative spice mix, and dolmades seasoning.
Stuff each grape leaf with the lentil mixture and roll up tightly.
Place the dolmades seam-side down in a baking dish and cover with foil.
Bake for 20 minutes, then remove the foil and bake for an additional 10 minutes.
